description:
CloudHypervisorMachine — the concrete, scheduled VM request for a Cloud
Hypervisor host.

You normally do not create this by hand: banlieue's controller does, owned
by the `VirtualMachine` it was scheduled from, and the host-resident
provider on the chosen host runs it as a Cloud Hypervisor guest.

apiVersion.description: APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.

kind.description: Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.

spec.description:
CloudHypervisorMachine — the concrete, scheduled VM request for a Cloud
Hypervisor host.

You normally do not create this by hand: banlieue's controller does, owned
by the `VirtualMachine` it was scheduled from, and the host-resident
provider on the chosen host runs it as a Cloud Hypervisor guest.

bootSource.description: Where the OS disk comes from.

image.description:
The image in the host's image cache: an installed raw disk for
`Image`, the installer ISO for
`InstallMedia`.

kind.description: Which provisioning shape this machine uses.

max.description:
Hotplug headroom: the most vCPUs the guest may be resized to. Fixed
when the VM is created. `None` means no headroom.

desiredPowerState.description: Desired power state, resolved from the parent `VirtualMachine`.

failureDomain.description:
CAPI contract (optional): failure domain placement. One host is one
failure domain on this backend, as on libvirt.

firstBootSealing.description:
First-boot sealing the guest must report before `GuestReady`
(ADR-0088, ADR-0112), copied by `banlieue-controller` from the parent
`VirtualMachine`'s `VMImage.spec.firstBootSealing` when the class is
`tpmEnabled`. The guest reports over its vsock (`sealed=` beside
`phase=installed`). `None` for every other machine, which keeps
today's `GuestReady` meaning unchanged.

partitions.description:
Kairos partition labels to seal on first boot. Defaults to
`[COS_PERSISTENT]`. `COS_OEM`, `COS_STATE`, `COS_RECOVERY` and
`COS_GRUB` are refused at admission, mirroring Kairos's own refusal.

timeoutSeconds.description:
Seconds from the machine's power-on (its infrastructure `Ready`
transition) within which the guest must report every listed partition
sealed; after that `GuestReady` is `False` with reason
`FirstBootSealingTimeout`. A clone that cannot seal halts in its
initramfs and never reports anything, so this is how it is noticed.

identity.description:
The guest identity this machine carries when it is not its own: set by
`banlieue-controller` on a move's destination machine to the source's
identity (ADR-0127 Decision 6). The provider derives the MAC, tap names,
machine directory and EK certificate subject from it instead of from
this machine's name and UID, so a moved guest keeps all of them. Absent
on every machine that was never the destination of a move. Immutable.

hugepages.description:
Back guest memory with hugepages. The host reports hugepages as their
own capacity, since they are reserved rather than allocated on demand.

moveIn.description:
This machine is a move's destination (ADR-0127 Decision 4). Set by
`banlieue-controller` at creation; the host provider prepares to receive.

commit.description:
Resume the received guest. Written only after the source reported
`Sent` and its VMM exited (Decision 5); never written with the source's
`abort`. One way.

peer.description: The source host, once it has published its certificate.

endpoint.description:
`host:port` the destination listens on. Set only on the source's
`moveOut.peer`: the source connects, the destination listens.

moveOut.description:
This machine is a move's source (ADR-0127 Decision 4). Set by
`banlieue-controller`; the host provider copies the guest out.

abort.description:
Give up before commit: resume the guest here (Decision 12). One way;
never written once the destination's `commit` is.

cutover.description: Pause the guest and send the disk delta and the VMM state. One way.

peer.description:
The destination host, once it has published its certificate and
endpoint.

endpoint.description:
`host:port` the destination listens on. Set only on the source's
`moveOut.peer`: the source connects, the destination listens.

ipam.description: IP address management for this interface.

poolRef.description:
Typed reference (apiGroup + kind + name + optional namespace).

Used wherever the referenced kind is pluggable — e.g. IPAM pools, where we
want to accept either `ipam.cluster.x-k8s.io/IPAddressClaim` (CAPI's
default) or future banlieue-native pool types.

static.description: Static IPAM parameters (address, prefix, gateway, nameservers, domain).

domain.description:
DNS domain, used both as a DNS search domain and (by a
`VirtualMachine.spec.networkOverrides` consumer, ADR-0024) to build
an FQDN as `<vm-name>.<domain>`.

macAddress.description:
Optional MAC address. The provider derives a stable one from the
machine UID otherwise, so the address survives a restart.

name.description: Stable NIC name; echoed in status.

networkClass.description:
Network class: a name the host resolves to one of its bridges. Never
a bridge name from the cluster.

osDiskSizeGiB.description:
OS disk size in GiB. Required, and grown to before first boot; never
shrunk. Must be at least the image's size.

providerID.description:
CAPI contract: Provider ID for the resulting Node, if this VM becomes
a Kubernetes node. Format:
`cloudhypervisor://<provider-name>/<machine-uid>`. Set by the provider
once the guest exists.

providerRef.description: The `Provider` for the one host that runs this machine (ADR-0060).

namespace.description:
Namespace of the `Provider`. Defaults to the referrer's namespace.

Only `banlieue-controller` may set this: a machine naming a provider in
another namespace is a placement that skipped scheduling, so an
admission policy reserves the field to the controller's identity.

storageClass.description:
Storage class the machine's disks live in. A name the host declares
in its local config and publishes on its failure domain; never a
path.

tpmEnabled.description:
Attach a vTPM (swtpm), resolved from the VM's `VMClass.spec.tpmEnabled`.
Requires `ChBootSourceKind::InstallMedia` (ADR-0040, ADR-0048,
ADR-0065), or an image that seals itself on first boot
(`Self::first_boot_sealing`, ADR-0088, ADR-0112).

userData.description:
Guest bootstrap payload, already resolved and placeholder-substituted
by `banlieue-controller` (ADR-0025, ADR-0038). Rendered into a
NoCloud `CIDATA` seed disk; the provider reads no Secret or ConfigMap.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: identity is set when the machine is created, or never

status.description:
Observed state of a CloudHypervisorMachine, shaped to the CAPI v1beta2
InfraMachine status contract. The non-contract fields mean what they mean
on `LibvirtMachineStatus`, so the controller's status mirror treats both
backends alike.

addressSource.description: Which source answered the provider's address lookup.

items.description: A typed machine address. Mirrors CAPI's `clusterv1.MachineAddress`.

type.description: Address type. Accepted: Hostname, ExternalIP, InternalIP, ExternalDNS, InternalDNS.

items.description: Condition contains details for one aspect of the current state of this API Resource.

lastTransitionTime.description: lastTransitionTime is the last time the condition transitioned from one status to another. This should be when the underlying condition changed.  If that is not known, then using the time when the API field changed is acceptable.

message.description: message is a human readable message indicating details about the transition. This may be an empty string.

observedGeneration.description: observedGeneration represents the .metadata.generation that the condition was set based upon. For instance, if .metadata.generation is currently 12, but the .status.conditions[x].observedGeneration is 9, the condition is out of date with respect to the current state of the instance.

reason.description: reason contains a programmatic identifier indicating the reason for the condition's last transition. Producers of specific condition types may define expected values and meanings for this field, and whether the values are considered a guaranteed API. The value should be a CamelCase string. This field may not be empty.

status.description: status of the condition, one of True, False, Unknown.

type.description: type of condition in CamelCase or in foo.example.com/CamelCase.

failureDomain.description: CAPI contract field (optional): observed failure domain.

guestInstalled.description:
Whether the installed guest has announced itself (ADR-0043). Sticky
once true.

hostUid.description:
The unprivileged host uid this machine's units run as (ADR-0063
Decision 3). Recorded so the provider re-adopts a running guest
without trusting its own memory.

provisioned.description:
True when the infrastructure provider reports that the resource's
infrastructure is fully provisioned.

installMediaDetached.description:
Whether the installer has been removed, live and for future starts
(ADR-0044, ADR-0065 Decision 4). Sticky once true; `None` when there
was never an installer.

moveIn.description: The destination side of a move, published by the host provider.

endpoint.description: `host:port` this host listens on for the move, from its `[move] listen`.

message.description: Why the move failed here, for a person.

moveId.description: The move this reports on; a report for another move id is stale.

phase.description: Where the destination host is in a move (ADR-0127 Decision 4).

moveOut.description: The source side of a move, published by the host provider.

certificate.description:
This host's per-move certificate, PEM. The private key never leaves
the host and is discarded when the move ends.

message.description: Why the move failed here, for a person.

moveId.description: The move this reports on; a report for another move id is stale.

phase.description: Where the source host is in a move (ADR-0127 Decision 4).

observedGeneration.description: The `metadata.generation` this status was computed from.

observedPowerState.description: The VM's last observed run state.

sealedPartitions.description:
Partitions the guest has reported sealed, as LUKS containers, on a
first-boot sealing machine (ADR-0088, ADR-0112): from the `sealed=`
line of its vsock report. **Sticky**: the report is re-sent every boot,
and a powered-off machine has not become unsealed. Empty until
reported, and on every machine without `spec.firstBootSealing`.
Guest-supplied, so it is only ever used to *withhold* `GuestReady`.

tpmAttached.description: Whether a vTPM was attached, when `spec.tpmEnabled` is set.

tpmEndorsementCertificates.description:
PEM EK certificates, validated against this machine (ADR-0045,
ADR-0065).
